review_candidates.title: Technical Presales Engineer
review_candidates.company: Information Technology of Egypt Corporation - ITE Corp
review_candidates.description: ITE Corp is currently looking for Technical Presales Engineer About the Role. The Technical Pre-Sales Engineer supports the Software Development & AI Department in converting client opportunities into compelling, technically credible proposals and demonstrations. This role works directly under the Head of Development and AI, assisting in the full presales lifecycle from solution framing to executive presentation with a focus on AI, cloud, and enterprise digital transformation services and products. Responsibilities: Presales & Solution Support •    Assist in preparing technical proposals, RFP/RFQ responses, and solution documents aligned with client requirements. •    Support the solution architect in mapping client business challenges to ITE Corp service offerings. •    Conduct initial research on client industries, competitors, and technology stacks prior to engagements. •    Prepare structured discovery questionnaires and follow-up documentation post-client meetings. Presentation & Slide Production •    Build executive-ready PowerPoint presentations translating technical architectures into business narratives. •    Design slides for CEO/CTO-level audiences: clear messaging, visual hierarchy, and business value focus. •    Convert raw architecture diagrams and technical content into polished, client-facing decks. •    Manage and maintain the ITE Corp presales slide library and reusable component templates. Technical POC & Demo Delivery •    Set up and configure Proof-of-Concept environments on Microsoft Azure under architect guidance. •    Build and demonstrate AI CoPilot scenarios using Copilot Studio and Azure OpenAI. •    Prepare demo data, scripts, and walkthrough narratives for client-facing POC sessions. •    Document POC outcomes, screenshots, and technical findings into structured summary reports. Service Alignment & Internal Coordination •    Develop deep familiarity with ITE Corp's full Development & AI Service Library. •    Assist in creating tailored service maps linking client needs to ITE Corp capabilities. •    Coordinate with internal technical teams to validate solution feasibility and effort estimates. •    Maintain organized presales documentation, proposal archives, and knowledge base. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or equivalent 3+ years of experience in technical pre-sales, solution engineering, or consulting support role. Exposure to enterprise software projects, cloud platforms, or AI product demonstrations. Experience producing presentations or technical documents for client-facing audiences. Familiarity with Egyptian enterprise market dynamics and client communication norms.

review_candidates.title: Integration and Data Engineer - Railway Infrastructure
review_candidates.description: We are looking for you as early as possible as Integration and Data Engineer for our Rail Operation Egypt for the primary location Cairo, Egypt . The role: Reporting to the Manager IT Projects and Applications, the Integration and Data Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the data pipelines, ETL processes, and system integrations that enable the high-speed railway organization to move, transform, and store data reliably across its application landscape. This is a hands-on engineering role at the core of how the organization turns raw operational data into trusted, accessible information for reporting and business intelligence. You are successful when data flows reliably between systems, pipelines are well built and maintainable, and the organization can count on clean and timely data to support its decisions. You also contribute to shaping the integration standards and patterns that guide how systems connect across the broader IT environment. Your responsibilities: Design, build, and maintain ETL and data pipeline solutions that move and transform data reliably across the organization's application and data landscape. Develop and maintain system integrations between enterprise applications, ensuring data flows are accurate, timely, and aligned to defined integration patterns. Contribute to the definition and continuous improvement of integration standards and patterns, bringing practical engineering insight to architecture-level decisions. Ensure data quality and consistency across pipelines, implementing validation, monitoring, and error handling that catches and resolves issues before they affect downstream consumers. Build and maintain data storage solutions and data models that support business intelligence and reporting needs, ensuring data is structured for reliable and efficient consumption. Monitor pipeline and integration health proactively, resolving failures quickly and implementing lasting fixes that improve reliability over time. Document data flows, pipeline architectures, and integration designs clearly, ensuring solutions are understandable and maintainable by others. Support the onboarding of new data sources and application integrations, working from business requirements to deliver solutions that are fit for purpose and built to standard. Participate in change management processes, ensuring pipeline and integration changes are reviewed, tested, and safely deployed. Collaborate with business stakeholders and application teams to understand data needs, translating requirements into practical engineering solutions that deliver measurable value. Your profile/ qualifications: Formal education in IT, Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field is welcome but what matters most is demonstrated hands-on experience building data pipelines and integrations. 3–5 years of experience in data engineering, ETL development, or systems integration in an enterprise environment. Strong hands-on experience with ETL tooling and data pipeline development, including transformation logic, scheduling, and error handling. Practical experience building system integrations using APIs, event-driven patterns, or iPaaS platforms. Solid understanding of data modeling, data quality principles, and structuring data for BI and reporting consumption. Comfortable contributing to integration standards and patterns, with the technical depth to engage meaningfully in architecture-level discussions. A developer mindset, writing clean, well-documented, and maintainable code and configurations that others can build on. Familiar with cloud data services, particularly in Azure, and comfortable working across hybrid environments. Relevant certifications are a plus, particularly Microsoft DP-203, Azure Data Engineer Associate, or equivalent data engineering credentials. Arabic required; strong professional English essential. This role is for someone who finds satisfaction in making data move reliably and cleanly, cares about the quality of what they build, and wants to be at the center of how a major national infrastructure project turns operational data into business insight.

review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer (Oracle Cloud EPM)
review_candidates.description: Job Description This role does not offer visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future sponsorship (including CPT, OPT, TN, or H-1B). This is a hybrid position with an onsite requirement of 1-2 days per week. Candidates must reside within a reasonable commuting distance (approximately 50 miles) of either our Alpharetta, GA or Oakland, CA office to support onsite collaboration. The Senior Software Engineer, Cloud EPM, is responsible for designing, developing, configuring, and supporting enterprise-scale Oracle Cloud EPM solutions that enable financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, consolidation, reporting, and analytics. This highly skilled techno-functional professional possesses deep expertise in Oracle EPM Cloud, including EPBCS, FCCS, ARCS, Cost Allocations, Strategic Modeling, and ERP integrations. This role plays a critical part in implementing and maintaining enterprise EPM solutions, managing data extraction, loading and reconciliation processes, and developing financial reports. The individual will design, configure, and enhance Oracle Cloud EPM modules, including Planning (PBCS/EPBCS), Financial Consolidation and Close (FCCS), Account Reconciliation (ARCS), Enterprise Data Management (EDMCS), Narrative Reporting, and Reporting & Analytics. The ideal candidate will develop and maintain business rules, calculation scripts, Groovy scripts, and automation processes while designing dimensional models, metadata structures, hierarchies, and security frameworks aligned with Finance and Accounting requirements. This role will also build and support inbound and outbound integrations to ensure seamless data flow across systems using Data Management (DM/FDMEE concepts), REST APIs, EPM Automate, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), and other middleware tools. Additionally, the Senior Software Engineer will provide production support for Oracle Cloud EPM applications, troubleshoot complex technical and functional issues, lead upgrades and environment refresh activities, and design, develop, and maintain BI Publisher reports to support business reporting needs. Responsibilities Design, develop, configure, and support Oracle Cloud EPM applications, including Planning (PBCS/EPBCS), FCCS, ARCS, EDMCS, Narrative Reporting, and Reporting & Analytics. Design, develop, and support integrations across the Oracle EPM Cloud ecosystem, including Planning, PCM, Narrative Reporting, ARCS, and FCCS. Build and maintain integrations between Oracle EPM Cloud and source systems such as Oracle ERP Cloud, legacy general ledger systems, and data warehouses. Develop and maintain business rules, calculation scripts, Groovy scripts, and automation processes. Design dimensional models, metadata structures, hierarchies, and security frameworks aligned with business and finance requirements. Automate data loads, metadata refreshes, financial close processes, and reconciliation activities. Manage inbound and outbound data integrations using Data Management, REST APIs, EPM Automate, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), and other middleware technologies. Design, develop, and maintain BI Publisher (BIP) reports and reporting solutions. Provide production support and troubleshoot complex functional and technical issues. Lead application upgrades, patch testing, validation activities, and environment refreshes. Optimize application performance, calculations, and data processing volumes. Develop and execute testing strategies, including unit testing, regression testing, and automation where appropriate. Enforce governance, security, version control, and change management standards across EPM environments. Partner with Finance, Accounting, FP&A, and IT stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. Ensure accurate, timely, and automated financial close, consolidation, and reconciliation processes. Serve as a technical lead on EPM initiatives, system enhancements, and implementation projects. Mentor junior engineers and functional analysts while promoting engineering best practices. Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to deliver secure, scalable, and high-performing EPM applications. Demonstrate a continuous learning mindset and drive process improvement through automation and innovation. Qualifications 4+ years of relevant experience and a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Experience implementing Oracle EPM Cloud solutions through multiple implementation cycles. Strong experience with Oracle Cloud EPM modules, including Planning (PBCS/EPBCS), FCCS, ARCS, EDMCS, Narrative Reporting, and Reporting & Analytics. Experience designing and developing integrations between Oracle EPM Cloud and enterprise systems using REST APIs, EPM Automate, Data Management, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), or similar technologies. Experience designing and developing highly scalable, secure enterprise applications and solutions. Experience with Oracle Cloud ERP integrations is preferred. Exposure to SOX controls, audit compliance requirements, and financial systems governance. Oracle EPM certifications (ARCS, FCCS, or EPM Cloud) are a plus. Ability to understand business objectives and translate requirements into effective technical solutions and business cases. Ability to evaluate existing business processes and partner with stakeholders to develop more efficient and automated workflows. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to anticipate challenges and proactively develop solutions. Experience mentoring, coaching, and guiding junior engineers and technical team members. Demonstrated ability to perform quantitative analysis and assess the value and impact of technology solutions. Knowledge of organizational processes and experience identifying and implementing process improvements. Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies and Agile development practices. Ability to collaborate effectively with Finance, Accounting, FP&A, IT, and external vendor partners. Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills. Experience developing and maintaining strategic vendor relationships while staying current on emerging technologies and industry best practices. Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning, innovation, and process improvement. Base Pay Information The national base pay range at the end is a good-faith estimate of what Delta Dental may pay for new hires. Actual pay may vary based on Delta Dental’s assessment of the candidate’s knowledge, skills, abilities (KSAs), related experience, education, certifications and ability to meet required minimum job qualifications. Other factors impacting pay include prevailing wages in the work location and internal equity. Pay Grade 22. $93,445 - $202,465 About Us Behind the smile! We are dedicated to safeguarding the health and financial stability of our employees and their loved ones. This commitment extends beyond the workplace to foster personal growth and holistic wellbeing. Our life-changing rewards package includes: Competitive base and incentive pay 401(k) with robust matching and non-matching contributions Rich medical & pharmacy benefits 100% employer-paid dental and vision benefits Holistic wellbeing program with deep financial incentives Generous paid time off plus 12 paid holidays and your birthday off Culture of growth and learning: career development; tuition reimbursement; recognition program Family support: adoption assistance, fertility treatment, child, elder & pet care assistance Social responsibility and volunteer opportunities Employee discount program Fair Chance Ordinances and Criminal Background Considerations This position requires that the applicant undergo a background check. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with any applicable federal, state or local laws, including, but not limited to, the California Fair Chance Act, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and/or New York Corrections Law Article 23-A. review_candidates.description: Description About the Company Tesla Laboratories is a Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) providing Cyber Security, Intelligence Analysis, Financial Management, Facilities Engineering Services, and Program Management support to the Intelligence Community (IC), the Department of Defense (DoD), and other federal government customers. We take pride in fostering a culture that values family, professional growth, and long-term career development—setting us apart from other services companies. Application Developer The Sponsor delivers human capital management technologies and services to the workforce, including data analytics that enable business decisions. The Sponsor seeks to build an integrated enterprise IT support model to drive efficiencies in the talent space and better address strategic requirements associated with learning, training compliance, foreign language development and retention, job advertisements, selection, and performance. The development and successful implementation of this model requires experience with multiple IT skill sets, including AGILE project management, Commercial Off-the-Shelf (COTS) integration and configuration, specifically Service Now (SN), SN application design and development, enhancement, SN security risk management, and familiarity with requirements for system certification and accreditation. Requirements Demonstrated experience with development of ServiceNow applications. Demonstrated experience implementing industry best practices and associated technical solutions consistent with accessibility standards. Demonstrated experience using agile methodology. Demonstrated experience using Jira. Demonstrated experience proposing recommendations that provide business value while supporting business goals and objectives, with an emphasis on improving User Experience/User Interface (UX/Ul), reducing O&M, increasing quality and speed of delivery, transforming, and modernizing web-based application, system, and service components. Demonstrated experience analyzing and documenting web-based application, system, or service components and associated interfaces, including those with databases and web services/APis to assist in decision-making regarding future development. Demonstrate experience interfacing with web-based databases and providing reports generation. Demonstrated on-job experience with version control software like Github or Subversion. Demonstrated experience in managing Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3 support, using service management systems. Demonstrated experience developing IT support documents that include SOPs, digital IT workflows, IT knowledge base, pre and post deployment checklists, IT architectural diagrams, system security plans, and administrative processes. Demonstrated experience working with compliance or performance management applications. Certification(s); Service Now Developer Desired Skills Skills and demonstrated experiences that are highly desired but not required to perform the work include: Demonstrated experience working with the Sponsor and partner IT organizations. Demonstrated experience working with learning applications. Demonstrated experience working with language, compliance, and performance management applications. Demonstrated experience with cloud technologies. Demonstrated experience with networking and platform hosting technologies. Demonstrated experience with HTML5, CSS, XML, and JavaScript. Demonstrated experience with copyright and accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.0 AA). Demonstrated experience with Tableau. Benefits Tesla Laboratories offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and long-term success of our employees, including: Competitive compensation Health, dental, and vision insurance Retirement plan with company contribution Paid time off and federal holidays Professional development and training opportunities Supportive, family-focused company culture Opportunities for long-term career growth within a growing SDVOSB
